backend/main.mo: Motoko actor that manages wallet-to-swap ID mappings with timestamps, providing functions to add mappings, delete by time range, and query first or all mapping records.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features: Razorpay payment button integration, price update to ₹299, testimonials section restructuring, and professional design enhancements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, hooks, utilities, and pages with implementation details for the Techify landing page.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide with prerequisites and step-by-step instructions for building and deploying the Techify landing page to the Internet Computer.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind styles with OKLCH color system, enhanced typography hierarchy, professional shadow utilities, Techify brand gradients, and safe-area utilities for mobile.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Meta Pixel tracking code in head and noscript fallback image in body for analytics across all pages.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component with QueryClientProvider, client-side routing between landing and payment success pages, SPA PageView tracking, and canonical URL redirect from /thank-you to /payment-success.
frontend/src/components/PersistentBottom: Fixed bottom CTA bar displaying Canva Pro offer at ₹299 with integrated Razorpay payment button loaded via script tag.
frontend/src/constants/techify.ts: Centralized constants for contact details, UPI payment info, WhatsApp messages, pricing (₹299), Razorpay payment button ID, and comprehensive Canva Pro features array.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages backend actor instances based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useLivePurchases.ts: React Query hook that fetches live purchase activity from backend with 5-second polling, transforming MappingInfo records into display-friendly events with relative timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useMetaPixelSpaPageVi: React hook that tracks Meta Pixel PageView events on SPA route changes, skipping the initial mount to avoid double-firing with the base pixel code.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Intentionally minimal placeholder file; the app uses feature-specific hooks instead of a centralized queries file.
frontend/src/hooks/useSimulatedLivePurch: Client-side hook that generates fake live purchase activity with random Indian names, periodic updates, and tracks total increments since mount for scarcity badge calculation.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpiPayment.ts: Hook managing UPI payment flow with mobile deep-link attempts and desktop fallback UI, including robust clipboard copy functionality for UPI ID.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, Techify brand gradients, typography styles, and safe-area utilities for persistent bottom bars.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Payment confirmation page that displays order summary, fires Meta Pixel Purchase event with deduplication, and provides WhatsApp contact and home navigation buttons.
frontend/src/pages/TechifyLandingPage.ts: Main landing page for Canva Pro subscription with simulated live purchases, countdown timer, testimonials, feature list, FAQ accordion, Razorpay integration, and persistent bottom CTA bar.
frontend/src/pages/ThankYouPage.tsx: Redirect page that immediately replaces URL with /payment-success and triggers navigation to avoid /thank-you being the canonical success URL.
frontend/src/utils/clipboard.ts: Robust clipboard utility that attempts modern Clipboard API first, then falls back to legacy execCommand method, returning success/failure results without throwing errors.
frontend/src/utils/metaPixel.ts: Meta Pixel tracking utilities with safe guards for PageView and Purchase events that silently fail when fbq is unavailable due to ad blockers or privacy extensions.
frontend/src/utils/purchaseDedup.ts: Utility for preventing duplicate Meta Pixel Purchase events using localStorage to track if a purchase event has already been fired.
frontend/src/utils/upi.ts: Generates UPI payment deep links and WhatsApp links for support, payment confirmation, and form submission with pre-filled messages.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color system using OKLCH, extended spacing, border radius, shadows, and typography plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting Razorpay integration, pricing updates to ₹299, layout restructuring, and design enhancements for a professional Canva Pro subscription website.
